newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 17.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - President Henri Konan Bedie says in address to Food and Agriculture Organisation in Rome that Ivory Coast will become West Africa's bread-basket. - Africa must base its future industrialisation on processing of its raw materials but the first step should be cooperation with First World companies, Ivorian junior minister for planning and industrial development Theophile Ahoua Ndoli says in interview ahead of the launch next week in Ivory Coast of the Alliance for African Industrialisation. Ministers meet Monday and Tuesday, heads of state on Wednesday. LA VOIE - The Ivorian government, quick to respond during ethnic clashes in an opposition stronghold before last October's presidential election, has yet to respond following fresh incident in August in which group of migrant farmers from President Bedie's Baoule tribe set fire to village of local Bakoue tribe. LE JOUR - Five hotels owned by the folded state-owned tourism and hotel company SIETHO (Societe d'Expansion Touristique et Hoteliere) offered for sale as part of government's privatisation programme. Hotels in Dimbokro, Gagnoa, Man, Odienne and Seguela. Closing date for offers December 3. (Government announcement)
